text: The town gathers

Sonnet, the mayor, Haiku, the officer, Luna, and Terra, the doctor, won against Gemma and Sol, the two killers. On day one the town voted Gemma out after she deflected Sol's questions and dodged the others, and Terra's night-two protection blocked the killers' strike. On day two Haiku claimed officer and said Sol was a killer after checking him, while Sol claimed officer right back and called Haiku a killer. Sonnet kept pressing Sol's missed vote on Gemma, and the town voted Sol out, with Sol's own counterclaim not saving him.
